en.s: The Battle of Mogyoród took place on 14 March 1074. It was an internal conflict between Solomon, King of Hungary and his cousins duke Géza and Ladislaus, who were claiming rights to the throne. Solomon ruled for a few years, during which he allegedly submitted the country to the Holy Roman Empire as a vassal state to ensure his power over the kingdom at fear of his relatives usurping the throne.

zh.s: 莫焦罗德之战发生于1074年3月14日，是匈牙利国王所罗门与其堂兄弟盖佐公爵、拉斯洛之间的一场内战。两人认为自己有权继承王位。所罗门在位数年，据称为巩固王权、防止亲属篡位，曾让匈牙利成为神圣罗马帝国的附庸国。

en.s: The Battle of Montiel was fought on 14 March 1369 between the Franco-Castilian forces supporting Henry of Trastámara and the Granadian-Castilian forces supporting the reigning Peter of Castile.

zh.s: 蒙铁尔之战于1369年3月14日爆发，交战双方是支持特拉斯塔马拉的恩里克的法兰西—卡斯蒂利亚联军，以及支持在位国王佩德罗的格拉纳达—卡斯蒂利亚联军。

en.s: The Battle of Ivry was fought on 14 March 1590, during the French Wars of Religion. The battle was a decisive victory for Henry IV of France, leading Huguenot and English forces against the Catholic League by the Duc de Mayenne and Spanish forces under the Count of Egmont. Henry's forces were victorious and he went on to lay siege to Paris. The battle occurred on the plain of Épieds, Eure near Ivry (later renamed Ivry-la-Bataille), Normandy. Ivry-la-Bataille is located on the Eure River and about thirty miles west of Paris, at the boundary between the Île-de-France and the Beauce regions.

zh.s: 伊夫里战役于1590年3月14日法国宗教战争期间发生。法国国王亨利四世率领胡格诺派和英军，决定性地击败了马耶讷公爵率领的天主教联盟及埃格蒙特伯爵率领的西班牙军队。亨利获胜后继续围攻巴黎。战斗发生在诺曼底伊夫里附近、厄尔省埃皮耶的平原上。伊夫里后来改称伊夫里拉巴塔耶，位于厄尔河畔、巴黎以西约30英里，在法兰西岛与博斯地区交界处。

en.s: The Battle of Haengju took place on 14 March 1593 during the 1592–1598 Japanese invasion of Korea. The Japanese attack failed to overcome the fortress Haengjusanseong.

zh.s: 幸州山城之战于1593年3月14日在1592—1598年日本侵朝战争期间爆发。日军进攻未能攻下幸州山城要塞。

en.s: On March 14, 1647, Bavaria, Cologne, France and Sweden signed the Truce of Ulm during the Thirty Years’ War.

zh.s: 1647年3月14日，巴伐利亚、科隆、法国和瑞典在三十年战争期间签署《乌尔姆停战协定》。

en.s: The Penruddock Uprising was a Royalist revolt launched on 11 March 1655, intending to restore Charles II to the throne of England. It was led by John Penruddock, a Wiltshire landowner who fought for Charles I in the First English Civil War; intended as one of a number of co-ordinated risings, the others failed to take place and it was easily suppressed.

zh.s: 彭鲁多克起义是王党派于1655年3月11日发动的一场叛乱，意在恢复查理二世的英格兰王位。起义由威尔特郡地主约翰·彭鲁多克领导，他曾在第一次英国内战中为查理一世作战。起义原计划与其他地区的协调行动同时进行，但其他起义并未发生，这场叛乱也很快被镇压。

en.s: The Battle of Ronas Voe was a naval engagement between the English Royal Navy and the Dutch East India ship Wapen van Rotterdam on 14 March 1674 in Ronas Voe, Shetland as part of the Third Anglo-Dutch War. Having occurred 23 days after the signing of the Treaty of Westminster, it is likely to have been the final battle of the Third Anglo-Dutch War.

zh.s: 罗纳斯沃海战于1674年3月14日在设得兰群岛的罗纳斯沃海域爆发，是第三次英荷战争期间英国皇家海军与荷兰东印度公司的“鹿特丹之盾”号之间的一场海战。战斗发生在《威斯敏斯特条约》签署23天后，可能是第三次英荷战争的最后一战。

en.s: The Break of Dromore took place on 14 March 1689 near Dromore, County Down in the early stages of the Williamite War in Ireland. It featured Catholic Jacobite troops under Richard Hamilton and Protestant Williamite militia led by Hugh Montgomery and Arthur Rawdon. The Protestant forces were taken by surprise and there was little fighting, reflected in the term "Break", a Scottish word for rout.

zh.s: 德罗莫尔溃败于1689年3月14日在唐郡德罗莫尔附近发生，是爱尔兰威廉战争初期的一场战斗。理查德·汉密尔顿率领的天主教雅各派军队对阵休·蒙哥马利和亚瑟·罗登率领的新教威廉派民兵。新教军队遭到突袭，双方交战很少；“溃败”一词源自表示溃逃的苏格兰语。

en.s: The siege of Trichinopoly (14 March 1743 – 29 August 1743) was part of an extended series of conflicts between the Nizam of Hyderabad and the Maratha Empire for control of the Carnatic region. On 29 August 1743, after a six-month siege, Murari Rao surrendered, giving Nizam ul Mulk (Nizam) the suzerainty of Trichinopoly. By the end of 1743, the Nizam had regained full control of Deccan.

zh.t: 蒂鲁吉拉帕利围城战（1743年）
zh.s: 蒂鲁吉拉帕利围城战是海得拉巴尼扎姆国与马拉塔帝国为争夺卡纳提克地区控制权而发生的一系列冲突之一，持续时间为1743年3月14日至8月29日。围城六个月后，穆拉里·拉奥于8月29日投降，尼扎姆·乌尔·穆尔克由此取得蒂鲁吉拉帕利的宗主权。1743年底，尼扎姆重新完全控制德干地区。

en.t: Royal Navy Admiral John Byng was executed by firing squad for failing to "do his utmost" during the Battle of Minorca at the start of the Seven Years' War
en.s: Admiral of the Blue John Byng (baptised 29 October 1704 – 14 March 1757) was a Royal Navy officer and politician who was court-martialled and executed by firing squad. After joining the navy at the age of thirteen, he participated at the Battle of Cape Passaro in 1718. Over the next thirty years he built up a reputation as a solid naval officer and received promotion to vice-admiral in 1747.

zh.t: 英国海军约翰·宾海军上将因未在米诺卡战役中“竭尽全力”而被行刑队枪决
zh.s: 蓝旗海军上将约翰·宾（Admiral of the Blue，1704年10月29日受洗—1757年3月14日）是英国皇家海军军官和政治人物，曾受军事法庭审判，后被行刑队枪决。他13岁加入海军，1718年参加帕萨罗角海战。此后30年间，他逐渐以稳健的海军军官著称，并于1747年晋升为海军中将。

en.t: British garrison at Fort Charlotte surrenders to Spanish forces
en.s: On March 14, 1780, the British garrison at Fort Charlotte in Mobile surrendered to Spanish forces led by Bernardo de Gálvez.

zh.t: 夏洛特堡英军向西班牙军队投降
zh.s: 1780年3月14日，莫比尔夏洛特堡的英军向贝尔纳多·德·加尔维斯率领的西班牙军队投降。

en.s: The 1786 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on March 14, 1786, in order to elect the President of New Hampshire. (The office would be renamed to Governor in 1792.) Incumbent Anti-Federalist President John Langdon was defeated in his re-election bid by Federalist candidate John Sullivan, who had initially finished third during the previous President election.

zh.s: 1786年新罕布什尔州州长选举于3月14日举行。当时该职位称‘州主席’，1792年才改称‘州长’。现任反联邦党主席约翰·兰登竞选连任失败，败给联邦党候选人约翰·沙利文。沙利文在上次主席选举中最初排名第三。

en.t: Eli Whitney is granted a patent for the cotton gin
en.s: Eli Whitney Jr. (December 8, 1765 – January 8, 1825) was an American inventor, widely known for inventing the cotton gin in 1793, one of the key inventions of the Industrial Revolution that shaped the economy of the Antebellum South. Whitney's invention made upland short cotton into a profitable crop, which strengthened the economic foundation of slavery in the United States and prolonged the institution.

zh.t: 伊莱·惠特尼获轧棉机专利
zh.s: 小伊莱·惠特尼（1765年12月8日—1825年1月8日）是美国发明家，因于1793年发明轧棉机而广为人知。这项发明是塑造美国南北战争前南方经济的工业革命重要发明之一，使高地短绒棉成为有利可图的作物，加强了美国奴隶制的经济基础，也延长了奴隶制的存续。

en.s: The Battle of Genoa (also known as the Battle of Cape Noli and in French as Bataille de Gênes) was a fleet action fought between an Anglo-Neapolitan fleet and a French fleet on 13-14 March 1795 in the Gulf of Genoa during the Mediterranean campaign of 1793–1796. The French fleet was led by Counter-admiral Pierre Martin and comprised 13 ships of the line while the Anglo-Neapolitan fleet fleet, under Vice-Admiral of the Red William Hotham mustered 13 ships of the line.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 热那亚之战又称诺利角海战（法语：Bataille de Gênes），是1793—1796年地中海战役期间的一场舰队交战，于1795年3月13日至14日在热那亚湾爆发。交战双方是英那不勒斯联合舰队和法国舰队。法国舰队由海军少将皮埃尔·马丁指挥，拥有13艘战列舰；英那不勒斯舰队由红旗中将威廉·霍瑟姆指挥，也集结了13艘战列舰。

en.s: The 1797 New Hampshire gubernatorial election took place on March 14, 1797. Incumbent Federalist Governor John Taylor Gilman won re-election to a fourth term.

zh.s: 1797年新罕布什尔州州长选举于3月14日举行。现任联邦党州长约翰·泰勒·吉尔曼连任，赢得第4个任期。

en.s: The Dano-Swedish War of 1808–1809 was a war between Denmark–Norway and Sweden due to Denmark–Norway's alliance with France and Sweden's alliance with the United Kingdom during the Napoleonic Wars. Neither Sweden nor Denmark-Norway had wanted war to begin with but once pushed into it through their respective alliances, Sweden made a bid to acquire Norway by way of invasion while Denmark-Norway made ill-fated attempts to reconquer territories lost to Sweden in the 17th century.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1808—1809年丹麦—瑞典战争发生在拿破仑战争期间。丹麦—挪威与法国结盟，瑞典与英国结盟，因此双方交战。两国原本都不想开战，但被各自的盟约卷入后，瑞典试图入侵挪威，丹麦—挪威则试图收复17世纪被瑞典夺走的领土。
zh.n: 此条采用原文资料框列出的战争开始日期。

en.s: The 1809 New Hampshire gubernatorial election took place on March 14, 1809. Incumbent Democratic-Republican Governor John Langdon was defeated for re-election by Federalist candidate, Chief Justice of the New Hampshire Superior Court of Judicature Jeremiah Smith.

zh.s: 1809年新罕布什尔州州长选举于3月14日举行。现任民主共和党州长约翰·兰登竞选连任失败，败给联邦党候选人、州高等法院首席法官杰里迈亚·史密斯。

en.s: The Battle of Casal Novo was a rear-guard action fought on March 14, 1811, during Massena's retreat from Portugal. During this retreat a French division, under command of Michel Ney, conducted a series of sharp rear-guard actions. At Casal Novo, the recklessness of Sir William Erskine resulted in costly losses in the Light Division.

zh.s: 卡萨尔诺沃之战是一次后卫战，于1811年3月14日马塞纳率军撤出葡萄牙期间爆发。撤退途中，米歇尔·内伊指挥的法国师连续进行了几次激烈的后卫战。在卡萨尔诺沃，威廉·厄斯金爵士鲁莽行事，导致轻步兵师损失惨重。

en.s: The 1815 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on March 14, 1815. Incumbent Federalist Governor John Taylor Gilman defeated Democratic-Republican nominee William Plumer in a re-match of the previous year's election.

zh.s: 1815年新罕布什尔州州长选举于3月14日举行。现任联邦党州长约翰·泰勒·吉尔曼再次击败民主共和党候选人威廉·普卢默，两人曾在前一年的选举中交锋。

en.s: The 1820 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on March 14, 1820. Incumbent Democratic-Republican Governor Samuel Bell won re-election to a second term.

zh.s: 1820年新罕布什尔州州长选举于3月14日举行。现任民主共和党州长塞缪尔·贝尔连任，赢得第2个任期。

en.s: The Battle of Nowshera, also called the Battle of Tihri, Battle of Naushahra, or Battle of Pir Sabaq, was fought in March 1823 near Nowshera between the forces of Ranjit Singh and Afghan-Pashtun forces led by Mohammad Azim Khan, then a leading Barakzai figure in Afghan politics. The battle followed Sikh expansion across the Indus River, the temporary Sikh occupation of Peshawar in 1818, and the submission of Yar Muhammad Khan of Peshawar to the Lahore Darbar.

zh.s: 诺谢拉战役也称蒂赫里战役、瑙谢赫拉战役或皮尔萨巴克战役，于1823年3月在诺谢拉附近爆发。兰季特·辛格率领的部队与阿富汗—普什图军队交战，后者由当时阿富汗政坛巴拉克宰家族的重要人物穆罕默德·阿齐姆·汗领导。战役发生在锡克人越过印度河扩张之后；锡克人曾于1818年短暂占领白沙瓦，随后白沙瓦统治者亚尔·穆罕默德·汗向拉合尔王廷臣服。

en.s: The 1826 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on March 14, 1826, in order to elect the governor of New Hampshire. Incumbent Democratic-Republican governor David L. Morril defeated former Democratic-Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives Benjamin Pierce.

zh.s: 1826年新罕布什尔州州长选举于3月14日举行。现任民主共和党州长大卫·L.莫里尔，击败曾以民主共和党人身份担任州众议员的本杰明·皮尔斯。

en.s: The 1837 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on March 14, 1837, in order to elect the governor of New Hampshire. Incumbent Democratic governor Isaac Hill won re-election in a landslide against Whig nominee Joseph Healey and former Federalist Attorney General of New Hampshire George Sullivan in a rematch from the previous election.

zh.s: 1837年新罕布什尔州州长选举于3月14日举行。现任民主党州长艾萨克·希尔再次以压倒性优势击败辉格党候选人约瑟夫·希利，以及联邦党前州总检察长乔治·沙利文，赢得连任。三人曾在上次选举中交锋。

en.s: The 1843 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on March 14, 1843, in order to elect the governor of New Hampshire. Incumbent Democratic governor Henry Hubbard won re-election against Whig nominee and former member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives Anthony Colby, Conservative nominee John H. White and Liberty nominee Daniel Hoit.

zh.s: 1843年新罕布什尔州州长选举于3月14日举行。现任民主党州长亨利·哈伯德，击败辉格党候选人、前州众议员安东尼·科尔比、保守派候选人约翰·H.怀特，以及自由党候选人丹尼尔·霍伊特，赢得连任。

en.t: Written for the Teatro della Pergola in Florence, Macbeth was Verdi's tenth opera and premiered on 14 March 1847
en.s: Macbeth (Italian pronunciation: [ˈmakbet], also [makˈbɛt]) is an opera in four acts by Giuseppe Verdi, with an Italian libretto by Francesco Maria Piave and additions by Andrea Maffei, based on William Shakespeare's play of the same name. Written for the Teatro della Pergola in Florence, Macbeth was Verdi's tenth opera and premiered on 14 March 1847. It was the first Shakespeare play that Verdi adapted for the operatic stage.

zh.t: 威尔第歌剧《麦克白》首演
zh.s: 《麦克白》是朱塞佩·威尔第创作的四幕歌剧，意大利语剧本由弗朗切斯科·玛丽亚·皮亚韦撰写，安德烈亚·马菲补充，改编自威廉·莎士比亚的同名戏剧。该剧为佛罗伦萨佩尔戈拉剧院创作，是威尔第的第十部歌剧，于1847年3月14日首演。这是威尔第首次将莎士比亚戏剧改编成歌剧。

en.s: Legislative elections were held in France on 29 February and 14 March 1852, electing the first legislature of the French Second Empire. Emperor Napoleon III's Bonapartists won a huge majority consisting of 258 of the 261 seats (five Royalists allied with the Bonapartists). The Party of Order that had won a majority in the 1849 election was banned following their opposition to the 1851 coup by President Louis Napoleon Bonaparte.

zh.s: 法国于1852年2月29日和3月14日举行议会选举。原文将其称为法兰西第二帝国第一届议会选举，并称拿破仑三世的波拿巴派赢得261席中的258席，取得压倒性多数，另有5名保王派与波拿巴派结盟。曾在1849年选举中赢得多数的秩序党，因反对路易-拿破仑·波拿巴总统1851年的政变而被禁止活动。

en.s: In the 1853 Chicago mayoral election, Charles McNeill Gray defeated Josiah L. James in a landslide, winning by a 54-point margin. Incumbent mayor Walter S. Gurnee did not run for reelection. The election was held on March 14. Josiah L. James was a businessman in the lumber industry.

zh.s: 1853年芝加哥市长选举于3月14日举行，查尔斯·麦克尼尔·格雷以54个百分点的巨大优势击败约西亚·L·詹姆斯。时任市长沃尔特·S·格尼没有竞选连任。约西亚·L·詹姆斯是木材行业商人。

zh.s: 1854年新罕布什尔州州长选举于3月14日举行。民主党候选人、前州众议员纳撒尼尔·B.贝克，击败辉格党候选人、前州众议员詹姆斯·贝尔，以及一名自由土地党候选人。原文开始介绍后者曾任美国某项公职，但在职位和姓名尚未列出时中断。

en.s: The Battle of New Bern (also known as the Battle of New Berne) was fought on 14 March 1862, near the city of New Bern, North Carolina, as part of the Burnside Expedition of the American Civil War. The US Army's Coast Division, led by Brigadier General Ambrose E. Burnside and accompanied by armed vessels from the North Atlantic Blockading Squadron, were opposed by an undermanned and badly trained Confederate force of North Carolina soldiers and militia led by Brigadier General Lawrence O'B. Branch. Although the defenders fought behind breastworks that had been set up before the battle, their line had a weak spot in its center that was exploited by the attacking Federal soldiers.

zh.s: 新伯尔尼战役于1862年3月14日在北卡罗来纳州新伯尔尼附近发生，是美国内战期间伯恩赛德远征的一部分。安布罗斯·E.伯恩赛德准将率领美国陆军海岸师，并有北大西洋封锁舰队的武装舰艇随行。对阵的是劳伦斯·奥布赖恩·布兰奇准将指挥的北卡罗来纳州南军士兵和民兵，人数不足，训练也很差。守军虽依托战前修建的胸墙作战，但防线中央有一个薄弱点，被进攻的北军利用。

en.t: The Army of Northern Virginia was established on March 14, 1862, again under Johnston
en.s: The Army of Northern Virginia was a field army of the Confederate States Army in the eastern theater of the American Civil War. It was also the primary command structure of the Department of Northern Virginia. It was most often arrayed against the Union's Army of the Potomac.

zh.s: 北弗吉尼亚军团于1862年3月14日在约瑟夫·约翰斯顿指挥下再次组建，是美利坚联盟国陆军在美国内战东部战区的一支野战军，也是北弗吉尼亚部的主要指挥机构。它最常与联邦军波托马克军团交战。

en.s: The 1864 Arkansas gubernatorial election was held on March 14, 1864, in order to elect the Union governor of Arkansas. Independent nominee and incumbent Provisional Governor Isaac Murphy won the election as he ran unopposed.

zh.s: 阿肯色州于1864年3月14日举行选举，选出效忠联邦的州长。独立候选人、现任临时州长艾萨克·墨菲在没有对手的情况下当选。

en.s: The Battle of Fort DeRussy was the first engagement in the Red River Campaign of March–May 1864 in the American Civil War. The Union Army of the Gulf under General Banks aimed to capture Shreveport, state capital and headquarters of the Confederate command, west of the Mississippi. The operation was spearheaded by General A.J.

zh.s: 德鲁西堡战役是美国南北战争中红河战役（1864年3月至5月）的首次交战。班克斯将军率领的墨西哥湾联邦军计划攻占密西西比河以西的什里夫波特；该城是路易斯安那州首府，也是邦联军指挥部所在地。行动由A·J·将军率领的部队打头阵。

en.t: Rossini's Petite messe solennelle is first performed, by twelve singers, two pianists and a harmonium player in a mansion in Paris
en.s: Gioachino Rossini's Petite messe solennelle (Little Solemn Mass) was written in 1863, possibly at the request of Count Alexis Pillet-Will for his wife Louise, to whom it is dedicated. The composer, who had retired from composing operas more than 30 years before, described it as "the last of my péchés de vieillesse" (sins of old age). The extended work is a missa solemnis (solemn Mass), but Rossini ironically labeled it petite (little).

zh.t: 罗西尼的《小庄严弥撒》在巴黎一座宅邸首演，由12名歌手、两名钢琴家和一名簧风琴演奏者演出
zh.s: 焦阿基诺·罗西尼的《小庄严弥撒》写于1863年，可能是应亚历克西·皮耶-维尔伯爵之请，为其妻子路易丝创作并题献的作品。罗西尼当时已退出歌剧创作30多年，他把这部作品戏称为“晚年的最后一桩过错”。这是一部篇幅较长的庄严弥撒曲，罗西尼却给它取名“小庄严弥撒”。

en.s: The Battle of Newton was a minor skirmish that took place in the small town of Newton, Alabama, on 14 March 1865, during the final days of the U.S. Civil War. It was fought between local Home Guard troops and elements of the 1st Florida Cavalry (US), who had invaded the Wiregrass region of Alabama in violation of a directive given by Brigadier General Alexander Asboth, commanding Union forces in Pensacola, Florida.

zh.s: 1865年3月14日，美国内战接近尾声时，阿拉巴马州小镇牛顿发生了一场小规模战斗。交战双方为当地乡土卫队及北军第1佛罗里达骑兵团的部分部队。后者违反了驻佛罗里达州彭萨科拉的北军指挥官亚历山大·阿斯博思准将的命令，进入阿拉巴马州的怀尔格拉斯地区。

en.s: The 1865 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on March 14, 1865, in order to elect the Governor of New Hampshire. Republican nominee and incumbent Mayor of Manchester Frederick Smyth defeated Democratic nominee and former Mayor of Manchester Edward W. Harrington.

zh.s: 1865年新罕布什尔州州长选举于3月14日举行。共和党候选人、现任曼彻斯特市长弗雷德里克·史密斯，击败民主党候选人、前曼彻斯特市长爱德华·W.哈灵顿。

en.s: The 1871 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on March 14, 1871, in order to elect the Governor of New Hampshire. Democratic nominee and incumbent Mayor of Manchester James A. Weston defeated Republican nominee and former member of the U.S. House of Representatives from New Hampshire's 1st district James Pike, Temperance nominee Albert Comings and Labor Reform Party nominee Lemuel P. Cooper.

zh.s: 1871年新罕布什尔州州长选举于3月14日举行。民主党候选人、现任曼彻斯特市长詹姆斯·A.韦斯顿，击败共和党候选人、该州第1选区前联邦众议员詹姆斯·派克、禁酒派候选人阿尔伯特·卡明斯，以及劳工改革党候选人莱缪尔·P.库珀。

en.s: The 1874 FA Cup final was a football match between Oxford University and Royal Engineers on 14 March 1874 at Kennington Oval in London. It was the third final of the world's oldest football competition, the Football Association Challenge Cup (known in the modern era as the FA Cup). Both teams had previously reached the final but been defeated by Wanderers.

zh.s: 1874年3月14日，牛津大学队与皇家工兵队在伦敦肯宁顿椭圆球场进行足总杯决赛。这是世界上历史最悠久的足球赛事——英格兰足球总会挑战杯、即今天足总杯——的第3届决赛。两队此前都曾进入决赛，但均败给流浪者队。

en.s: The 1876 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on March 14, 1876, in order to elect the governor of New Hampshire. Incumbent Republican governor Person Colby Cheney won re-election against Democratic nominee and former member of the U.S. House of Representatives from New Hampshire's 1st district Daniel Marcy and Temperance nominee Asa S. Kendall.

zh.s: 1876年新罕布什尔州州长选举于3月14日举行。现任共和党州长珀森·科尔比·切尼，击败民主党候选人、该州第1选区前联邦众议员丹尼尔·马西，以及禁酒派候选人阿萨·S.肯德尔，赢得连任。

en.s: The 1896 Scottish Cup Final was played on 14 March 1896 at New Logie Green in Edinburgh and was the final of the 23rd season of the Scottish Cup. The Edinburgh derby rivals Hearts and Hibernian contested the match. Hearts won the match 3–1, thanks to goals from Davie Baird (penalty kick), Alex King and Willie Michael. Jo O'Neill scored a consolation goal for Hibs.

zh.s: 1896年苏格兰杯决赛于3月14日在爱丁堡的新洛吉格林球场举行，是该赛事第23个赛季的决赛，由爱丁堡德比对手哈茨与希伯尼安交锋。哈茨凭借戴维·贝尔德的点球，以及亚历克斯·金和威利·迈克尔的进球，以3比1获胜。乔·奥尼尔为希伯尼安打入一球，挽回些许颜面。

en.s: The Battle of Kanjaga was a battle in Africa that was fought between Babatu and the people of Kanjaga. The battle was claimed to have taken place on 14 March 1897. Babatu and his warriors were defeated by the unified forces of Ameria and the French.

zh.s: 坎贾加之战是非洲的一场战斗，交战双方是巴巴图和坎贾加人。据称战斗于1897年3月14日发生。巴巴图及其战士被阿梅里亚人与法国人组成的联军击败。

en.s: The Gold Standard Act was an Act of the United States Congress, signed by President William McKinley and effective on March 14, 1900, defining the United States dollar by gold weight and requiring the United States Treasury to redeem, on demand and in gold coin only, paper currency the Act specified.
en.n: This entry records the signing, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 《金本位法》是美国国会通过、由总统威廉·麦金莱签署的法律，于1900年3月14日生效。该法规定以黄金重量确定美元价值，并要求美国财政部按要求仅以金币兑换法案指定的纸币。
zh.n: 此条采用原文资料框列出的签署日期。

en.t: Pelican Island National Wildlife Refuge, the first national wildlife refuge in the US, is established by President Theodore Roosevelt
en.s: Pelican Island National Wildlife Refuge is a United States National Wildlife Refuge (NWR), and part of the Everglades Headwaters NWR complex, located just off the western coast of Orchid Island, Florida in the Indian River Lagoon east of Sebastian, Florida. The refuge consists of a 3-acre (12,000 m2) island that includes an additional 2.5 acres (10,000 m2) of surrounding water and is located off the east coast of Florida of the Indian River Lagoon.

zh.t: 西奥多·罗斯福总统设立鹈鹕岛国家野生动物保护区，这是美国首个国家级野生动物保护区
zh.s: 鹈鹕岛国家野生动物保护区是美国国家野生动物保护区的一部分，也属于大沼泽地源头保护区群。它位于佛罗里达州兰花岛西岸外侧、塞巴斯蒂安以东的印第安河潟湖内。保护区包括一座面积3英亩（约1.2万平方米）的岛屿及其周边另外2.5英亩（约1万平方米）的水域；它位于佛罗里达州东岸的印第安河潟湖内。

en.s: General elections were held in Italy on 7 March 1909, with a second round of voting on 14 March. The "ministerial" left-wing bloc remained the largest in Parliament, winning 329 of the 508 seats.
en.n: This entry records the second round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 意大利于1909年3月7日举行大选，第二轮投票于3月14日进行。“内阁派”左翼联盟仍是议会最大势力，赢得508个席位中的329席。

en.s: The Battle of Más a Tierra was a World War I sea battle fought on 14 March 1915, near the Chilean island of Más a Tierra, between a British squadron and a German light cruiser. The battle saw the last remnant of the German East Asia Squadron destroyed, when SMS Dresden was cornered and scuttled in Cumberland Bay.

zh.s: 马斯阿蒂埃拉海战是第一次世界大战期间的一场海战，于1915年3月14日在智利马斯阿蒂埃拉岛附近爆发，交战双方是英国分舰队和德国轻巡洋舰。德国东亚分舰队残部在此战中被消灭：“德累斯顿”号被逼至坎伯兰湾后自沉。

en.s: The Pancho Villa Expedition—now known officially in the United States as the Mexican Expedition but originally referred to as the "Punitive Expedition, U.S. Army"—was a military operation conducted by the United States Army against the paramilitary forces of Mexican revolutionary Francisco "Pancho" Villa from March 14, 1916, to February 7, 1917, during the Mexican Revolution 1910–1920. The expedition was launched in retaliation for Villa's attack on the town of Columbus, New Mexico, and was the most remembered event of the Border War. The declared objective of the expedition by the Wilson administration was the capture of Villa.

zh.s: 追捕潘乔·比利亚远征是美国陆军于1916年3月14日至1917年2月7日，针对墨西哥革命者弗朗西斯科·‘潘乔’·比利亚的准军事部队开展的军事行动，发生于1910至1920年的墨西哥革命期间。该行动在美国现正式称为‘墨西哥远征’，最初称‘美国陆军惩罚性远征’。美军为报复比利亚袭击新墨西哥州哥伦布镇而出兵，这也是边境战争中最为人熟知的事件。威尔逊政府宣布的目标是抓获比利亚。

en.t: Battle of Verdun: German attack captures Côte 265 at the west end of Mort-Homme but the French 75th Infantry Brigade manages to hold Côte 295 at the east end
en.s: The Battle of Verdun (French: Bataille de Verdun [bataj də vɛʁdœ̃]; German: Schlacht um Verdun [ʃlaxt ʔʊm ˈvɛɐ̯dœ̃]) was fought from 21 February to 18 December 1916 on the Western Front in France. The battle was the longest of the First World War and took place on the hills north of Verdun.

zh.t: 凡尔登战役：德军攻占莫尔特-奥姆高地西端的265高地，法军第75步兵旅守住东端的295高地
zh.s: 凡尔登战役（法语：Bataille de Verdun，[bataj də vɛʁdœ̃]；德语：Schlacht um Verdun，[ʃlaxt ʔʊm ˈvɛɐ̯dœ̃]）于1916年2月21日至12月18日在法国西线战场进行。它是第一次世界大战中持续时间最长的战役，战场位于凡尔登以北的丘陵地带。

en.t: Six members of the Forgotten Ten are hanged in Dublin
en.s: On March 14, 1921, six Irish Republican Army members were hanged at Mountjoy Prison in Dublin. They were among the prisoners later known as the Forgotten Ten.

zh.t: “被遗忘的十人”中六人在都柏林被处绞刑
zh.s: 1921年3月14日，六名爱尔兰共和军成员在都柏林蒙乔伊监狱被处绞刑。他们是后来被称为“被遗忘的十人”的囚犯中的六人。

en.t: Four anti-Treaty prisoners are executed at Drumboe
en.s: On March 14, 1923, Charlie Daly, Daniel Enright, Seán Larkin and Timothy O’Sullivan were executed by firing squad at Drumboe in County Donegal.

zh.t: 查理·戴利等四名囚犯在德拉姆博被处决
zh.s: 1923年3月14日，查理·戴利、丹尼尔·恩赖特、肖恩·拉金和蒂莫西·奥沙利文在多尼戈尔郡德拉姆博被行刑队枪决。

en.s: The El Virilla train accident occurred in Costa Rica on March 14, 1926 when an overcrowded train carrying mostly farmers and labourers derailed while crossing a bridge across the Virilla River Canyon, killing 248 and injuring 93. The train concerned was a Sunday excursion from Alajuela and Heredia to Cartago where most intended to visit the statue of the La Negrita at the Basílica de Nuestra Señora de Los Ángeles, which supposedly has great healing powers. The excursion was arranged to raise money for a home for the elderly by the noted Professor Francisco Gomez Alizago, tickets being inscribed "For the benefit of the elderly of Cartago".

zh.s: 1926年3月14日，哥斯达黎加一列严重超载的列车在通过比里亚河峡谷上的桥梁时脱轨，造成248人死亡、93人受伤，乘客大多是农民和工人。这是一趟星期日郊游列车，从阿拉胡埃拉和埃雷迪亚开往卡塔戈。多数乘客准备前往天使之后圣母大殿，参拜据说有治病能力的‘小黑人圣母’雕像。郊游由知名教授弗朗西斯科·戈麦斯·阿利萨戈组织，为一家养老院筹款，车票上写着‘为卡塔戈老年人谋福利’。

en.t: Alam Ara, India's first talking film, is released
en.s: Alam Ara (transl. Ornament of the World) is a 1931 Indian historical fantasy film directed and produced by Ardeshir Irani. It revolves around a king and his two wives, Navbahaar and Dilbahaar, who are childless; soon, a fakir (Wazir Muhammad Khan) tells the king that the former wife will give birth to a boy, later named Qamar (Master Vithal), but the child will die following his 18th birthday if Navbahaar cannot find the necklace he asks for.

zh.t: 印度首部有声电影《阿拉姆·阿拉》上映
zh.s: 《阿拉姆·阿拉》（意为“世界的装饰”）是1931年印度历史奇幻电影，由阿德希尔·伊拉尼执导并制作。影片讲述一位国王和他的两位妻子纳芙巴哈尔与迪尔巴哈尔的故事。两人都没有孩子，后来一位苦行僧瓦齐尔·穆罕默德·汗告诉国王，前一位妻子将生下一个男孩，名叫卡马尔（马斯特·维塔尔饰演）；如果纳芙巴哈尔找不到他要的项链，卡马尔将在18岁生日后死去。

en.s: The Battle of Czajánek's barracks (Czech: Bitva o Czajankovu kasárnu) was a confrontation between the Czechoslovak and German armies, which took place on 14 March 1939 in the course of the German occupation of Czechoslovakia. Together with a clash which allegedly took place at Moravská Třebová, this was the only known active Czechoslovak resistance to the German Army during the occupation of Bohemia and Moravia in March 1939.

zh.s: 恰亚内克兵营之战（捷克语：Bitva o Czajankovu kasárnu）是捷克斯洛伐克军队与德国军队的一次交战，发生于1939年3月14日德国占领捷克斯洛伐克期间。与据称发生在摩拉夫斯卡特热博瓦的一次冲突一样，这是1939年3月波希米亚和摩拉维亚遭占领期间，已知唯一一次捷克斯洛伐克军队对德军的主动抵抗。

en.s: Supreme Soviet elections were held in the Soviet Union on 14 March 1954.

zh.s: 苏联于1954年3月14日举行最高苏维埃选举。

en.s: General elections were held in India between 24 February and 14 March 1957, the second elections to the Lok Sabha after independence. Elections to several state legislatures were held simultaneously. Under the leadership of Jawaharlal Nehru, the Indian National Congress easily won a second term in power, taking 371 of the 494 seats.

zh.s: 印度于1957年2月24日至3月14日举行独立后的第二次人民院选举，同时举行数个邦的议会选举。贾瓦哈拉尔·尼赫鲁领导的印度国民大会党赢得494席中的371席，轻松取得第二届执政任期。

en.s: On 14 March 1961 an aircraft accident occurred near Yuba City, California. A United States Air Force B-52F-70-BW Stratofortress bomber, AF Serial No. 57-0166, c/n 464155, carrying two nuclear weapons departed from Mather Air Force Base near Sacramento. According to the official USAF report, the aircraft experienced an uncontrolled decompression that required it to descend to 10,000 feet (3,000 m) in order to lower the cabin altitude. Increased fuel consumption caused by having to fly at lower altitude, combined with the inability to rendezvous with a tanker in time caused the aircraft to run out of fuel.

zh.s: 1961年3月14日，加利福尼亚州尤巴城附近发生飞机事故。美国空军一架B-52F-70-BW‘同温层堡垒’轰炸机携带两枚核武器，从萨克拉门托附近的马瑟空军基地起飞。飞机空军序列号为57-0166，制造编号为464155。空军官方报告称，飞机发生无法控制的失压，必须下降到10,000英尺（3,000米）以降低座舱高度。低空飞行使耗油量增加，又未能及时与加油机会合，最终燃油耗尽。

en.t: The body of U.S. President John F. Kennedy is moved to a permanent burial place at Arlington National Cemetery
en.s: John Fitzgerald Kennedy (May 29, 1917 – November 22, 1963), also known as JFK, was the 35th president of the United States, serving from 1961 until his assassination in 1963. He was the youngest person elected president, at 43 years, and the first Catholic president. Kennedy served at the height of the Cold War, and the majority of his foreign policy concerned relations with the Soviet Union and Cuba.

zh.t: 美国总统约翰·F·肯尼迪的遗体迁至阿灵顿国家公墓的永久安葬地
zh.s: 约翰·菲茨杰拉德·肯尼迪（1917年5月29日—1963年11月22日），也称JFK，是美国第35任总统，1961年就任，1963年遇刺身亡。他以43岁之龄当选，是当选时最年轻的总统，也是首位天主教总统。肯尼迪执政时期正值冷战高峰，其外交政策大多围绕与苏联和古巴的关系展开。

en.s: On 14 March 1972, Sterling Airways Flight 296 crashed into a mountain ridge on approach to Dubai in Al Hayl, Fujariah. Flight 296 was a charter flight from Colombo to Copenhagen with stops in Bombay, Dubai, and Ankara. All 112 passengers and crew on board died in the crash which was attributed to pilot error. The flight was operated by a Sud Aviation Caravelle, registration OY-STL.

zh.t: 斯特林航空296号航班空难
zh.s: 1972年3月14日，斯特林航空296号航班在进近迪拜途中，撞上富查伊拉哈伊勒地区的一道山脊。该航班是从科伦坡飞往哥本哈根的包机，途中经停孟买、迪拜和安卡拉。机上乘客及机组人员共112人全部遇难，事故归因于飞行员失误。执飞的是一架法国南方航空制造公司的‘快帆’客机，注册号为OY-STL。

en.t: 1976 All-Ireland Senior Club Hurling Championship final
en.s: The 1976 All-Ireland Senior Club Hurling Championship final was a hurling match played at Croke Park on 14 March 1976, to determine the winners of the 1975–76 All-Ireland Senior Club Hurling Championship, the sixth season of the All-Ireland Senior Club Hurling Championship, a tournament organised by the Gaelic Athletic Association for the champion clubs of the four provinces of Ireland.

zh.t: 1976年全爱尔兰高级俱乐部曲棍球锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 1976年全爱尔兰高级俱乐部曲棍球锦标赛决赛于1976年3月14日在克罗克公园举行，是1975—76赛季的决赛。盖尔运动协会为爱尔兰四个省份的冠军俱乐部举办这项赛事，这已是第六个赛季。

en.t: Guinea v Morocco (1976 African Cup of Nations)
en.s: Guinea v Morocco was the decisive match of group stage at the 1976 African Cup of Nations. The match was played at the Addis Ababa Stadium in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, on 14 March 1976. Unlike most other Africa Cup of Nations, the 1976 winner was determined by a final group stage, with the final four teams playing in round-robin format, instead of a knockout stage.

zh.t: 几内亚对摩洛哥（1976年非洲国家杯）
zh.s: 几内亚对摩洛哥是1976年非洲国家杯小组赛的关键一战，于1976年3月14日在埃塞俄比亚亚的斯亚贝巴体育场举行。与多数非洲国家杯不同，1976年赛事通过最后阶段的小组赛决出冠军，最后四支球队以循环赛方式交手，而非进行淘汰赛。

en.s: The 1978 South Lebanon conflict, also known as the First Israeli invasion of Lebanon and codenamed Operation Litani by Israel, began when Israel invaded southern Lebanon up to the Litani River in March 1978. It was in response to the Coastal Road massacre near Tel Aviv by Palestinian militants based in Lebanon. The conflict resulted in the deaths of 1,100–2,000 Lebanese and Palestinians, 20 Israelis, and the internal displacement of 100,000 to 250,000 people in Lebanon.

zh.s: 1978年黎巴嫩南部冲突也称第一次以色列入侵黎巴嫩；以色列将行动代号定为“利塔尼行动”。1978年3月，以色列军队入侵黎巴嫩南部，推进至利塔尼河，冲突由此开始。此次行动是为回应黎巴嫩境内巴勒斯坦武装分子在特拉维夫附近制造的沿海道路大屠杀。冲突造成1,100至2,000名黎巴嫩人和巴勒斯坦人、20名以色列人死亡，另有10万至25万黎巴嫩人流离失所。

en.s: The 1979 Alberta general election was held on March 14, 1979, to elect members of the Legislative Assembly of Alberta, which had been expanded to 79 seats. The Progressive Conservative Party of Peter Lougheed won its third consecutive term in government. During the campaign, some Progressive Conservatives spoke of winning "79 in '79", i.e., all 79 seats in the legislature.

zh.s: 1979年艾伯塔省大选于1979年3月14日举行，选出扩充至79席的艾伯塔省立法议会议员。彼得·洛希德领导的进步保守党政府连续第三次执政。竞选期间，部分进步保守党人提出“79年拿下79席”的口号，即争取赢得全部79席。

en.t: Alia Royal Jordanian Flight 600 crashes at Doha International Airport, killing 45 people
en.s: Alia Royal Jordanian Flight 600 was a scheduled international passenger flight from Marka International Airport, Jordan, to Seeb International Airport, Muscat, Oman, via Doha International Airport in Qatar. On the night of 13 March 1979, the Boeing 727 operating the flight was carrying out a missed approach to Doha's Runway 34 when it flew into a downburst, causing the aircraft to crash onto the runway, flip over and slide tail-first into a fire station, killing 41 passengers and 4 crew.

zh.t: 阿莉娅皇家约旦航空600号班机在多哈国际机场坠毁，45人遇难
zh.s: 阿莉娅皇家约旦航空600号班机是一趟定期国际客运航班，从约旦马尔卡国际机场飞往阿曼马斯喀特的塞卜国际机场，途中经停卡塔尔多哈国际机场。1979年3月13日晚，这架波音727在尝试降落多哈34号跑道时遭遇下击暴流，随后坠上跑道、翻覆，并尾部朝前滑入一座消防站；41名乘客和4名机组人员遇难。

en.s: LOT Polish Airlines Flight 007 was an Ilyushin Il-62 that crashed near Warsaw-Okecie Airport in Poland, on 14 March 1980, as the crew aborted a landing and attempted to go-around, killing all 77 passengers and 10 crew members on board. It was caused by the disintegration of a turbine disc in one of the plane's engines, leading to uncontained engine failure.

zh.s: 1980年3月14日，波兰航空007号航班执飞的一架伊尔-62客机，在机组中止降落并尝试复飞时，于波兰华沙奥肯切机场附近坠毁。机上77名乘客和10名机组人员全部遇难。事故原因是一台发动机的涡轮盘解体，引发非包容性发动机失效，即破片突破发动机机匣。

en.t: 1982 bombing of the African National Congress headquarters in London
en.s: The London offices of the African National Congress (ANC) were wrecked by an 11-kilogram (24 lb) bomb which exploded against the rear wall at 9 am on 14 March 1982. Windows up to 400 yd (370 m) away were broken. Caretaker Vernet Mbatha, an ANC voluntary worker, who was sleeping in a flat above the offices, was injured.

zh.t: 1982年非洲人国民大会伦敦总部爆炸案
zh.s: 1982年3月14日上午9时，一枚重11千克（24磅）的炸弹在非洲人国民大会（ANC）伦敦办事处后墙附近爆炸，办公场所严重受损。爆炸震碎了400码（370米）外的窗户。睡在楼上公寓的看门人、ANC志愿工作人员维内特·姆巴塔受伤。

en.s: The Johnson South Reef Skirmish of 1988 (Chinese: 赤瓜礁海战; pinyin: Chìguā jiāo hǎizhàn; literally: "Naval Battle of Chigua Reef"; Vietnamese: Hải chiến Trường Sa, lit: "Spratly Islands naval battle", or Vietnamese: Hải chiến Gạc Ma, lit: "Johnson South Reef naval battle") was a naval battle that took place between Chinese and Vietnamese forces over Johnson South Reef in the Spratly Islands on 14 March 1988.

zh.s: 赤瓜礁海战是中国与越南军队于1988年3月14日在南沙群岛赤瓜礁发生的海上交战。越南语中也称这场战斗为‘长沙群岛海战’或‘赤瓜礁海战’。

en.s: Operation Beit ol-Moqaddas 3 (Persian: عملیات بیت المقدس 3) was a military operation during the Iran–Iraq War, which was launched on 14 March 1988 by Iran. Its code name was "Ya Mousa ibn Jafar" (Persian: یاموسی‌بن‌جعفر). The mission's goal was to capture the heights of (the north of) Sulaymaniyah, and also respond the Iraqi bombardment of residential areas in Sulaymaniyah Governorate.

zh.s: ‘耶路撒冷3号行动’是伊朗于1988年3月14日在两伊战争期间发动的军事行动，行动口令为‘穆萨·伊本·贾法尔啊’。其目标是夺取苏莱曼尼亚北部的高地，并回应伊拉克对苏莱曼尼亚省居民区的轰炸。

en.s: The 1990 Soviet Union presidential election was held in the Soviet Union on 14 March 1990 to elect a president for a five-year term. This was the first and only presidential election to be held in the Soviet Union. This was due to the office of president being established in 1990, a year before the dissolution of the Soviet Union in 1991.

zh.s: 1990年3月14日，苏联举行总统选举，选出任期五年的总统。这是苏联唯一一次总统选举，因为总统职位设立于1990年，苏联于1991年解体。

en.t: Escondida copper mine begins operating in Chile
en.s: On March 14, 1991, the Escondida copper mine in Chile began operating.

zh.s: 1991年3月14日，智利埃斯康迪达铜矿开始运营。

en.t: Norman Thagard becomes the first American astronaut to ride to space on board a Russian launch vehicle
en.s: Norman Earl Thagard (born July 3, 1943; Capt, USMC, Ret.) is an American scientist and former U.S. Marine Corps officer and naval aviator and NASA astronaut. He is a veteran of five space flights and on March 14, 1995, he became the first American to ride to space on board a Russian vehicle, the Soyuz TM-21 spacecraft for the Russian Mir-18 mission.

zh.t: 诺曼·萨加德成为首位乘俄罗斯运载火箭进入太空的美国人
zh.s: 诺曼·厄尔·萨加德（1943年7月3日生）是美国科学家、前海军陆战队军官、海军飞行员和NASA宇航员，曾执行五次太空飞行。1995年3月14日，他乘坐俄罗斯“联盟TM-21”飞船执行“和平号18号”任务，成为首位搭乘俄罗斯航天器进入太空的美国人。

en.t: On 14 March 1995, Norman Thagard became the first American to ride to space on board a Russian launch vehicle, and thus became the first "American cosmonaut"
en.s: An astronaut (from the Ancient Greek ἄστρον (astron), meaning 'star', and ναύτης (nautes), meaning 'sailor') is a person trained, equipped, and deployed by a human spaceflight program to serve as a commander or crew member of a spacecraft. Although generally reserved for professional space travelers, the term is sometimes applied to anyone who travels into space, including scientists, politicians, journalists, and space tourists.

zh.t: 1995年3月14日，诺曼·萨加德成为首位乘坐俄罗斯运载火箭进入太空的美国人，也因此成为首位“美国航天员”
zh.s: 宇航员（astronaut一词源自古希腊语ἄστρον〔astron，意为“星”〕和ναύτης〔nautes，意为“水手”〕）是受载人航天计划训练、配备装备并派遣执行任务的人员，担任航天器指挥官或乘组成员。这个词通常指职业太空旅行者，有时也用于泛指任何进入太空的人，包括科学家、政治人物、记者和太空游客。

en.s: Operation Dragonfly, in German Operation Libelle, was an evacuation operation of the German Armed Forces in the Albanian capital Tirana on March 14, 1997. In the same week, American, British and Italian military forces evacuated their citizens from Albania. Operation Libelle is the first time since World War II that German infantry soldiers fired shots in combat.

zh.s: ‘蜻蜓行动’是德国联邦国防军于1997年3月14日在阿尔巴尼亚首都地拉那实施的撤离行动。同一周，美国、英国和意大利军队也从阿尔巴尼亚撤离本国公民。这是第二次世界大战后德国步兵首次在战斗中开枪。

en.s: The 1999 Uncensored was the fifth Uncensored professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by World Championship Wrestling (WCW). The event took place on March 14, 1999, from Freedom Hall in Louisville, Kentucky. Nine matches were contested at the event. In the main event, Ric Flair defeated Hollywood Hogan in a Barbed Wire Steel Cage First Blood match to win the WCW World Heavyweight Championship and become President of WCW for life.

zh.s: 1999年‘不受审查’是世界冠军摔角（WCW）举办的第5届同名按次付费职业摔角赛事，于3月14日在肯塔基州路易斯维尔的自由大厅举行，共进行9场比赛。压轴赛中，瑞克·弗莱尔在带刺铁笼先见血赛中击败好莱坞·霍根，赢得WCW世界重量级冠军，并成为WCW终身总裁。

en.s: The 2000 Orlando mayoral election took place on March 14, 2000. Incumbent Mayor Glenda Hood ran for re-election to a third term. She was challenged by three candidates, with City Councilmember Bruce Gordy emerging as her main competitor. The campaign was the most expensive in city history, though Hood was viewed as the likely victor.

zh.s: 2000年奥兰多市长选举于3月14日举行。现任市长格伦达·胡德争取第三个任期，面对三名挑战者，其中市议员布鲁斯·戈迪成为主要对手。尽管胡德被认为很可能获胜，这场竞选仍成为该市历史上花费最高的一次。

en.s: The 2000 Fort Lauderdale mayoral election took place on March 14, 2000. Incumbent Mayor Jim Naugle ran for re-election to a fourth term. He was only challenged by Anthony G. Evans Jr., a minister and pharmacy manager. Naugle was endorsed for re-election by the Miami Herald and the Sun Sentinel.

zh.s: 2000年劳德代尔堡市长选举于3月14日举行。现任市长吉姆·诺格尔争取第四个任期，唯一对手是牧师兼药店经理小安东尼·G.埃文斯。《迈阿密先驱报》和《太阳哨兵报》均支持诺格尔连任。

en.s: The 2000 Texas Democratic presidential primary took place on March 14, 2000, as one of 6 contests scheduled on the week following Super Tuesday in the Democratic Party primaries for the 2000 presidential election, following the Nevada caucuses the weekend before. The Texas primary was an open primary, with the state awarding one the largest amounts of national convention delegates on Mini Tuesday and third-largest amount overall: 231 delegates, of which 194 were pledged delegates allocated on the basis of the primary.

zh.t: 2000年得克萨斯州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2000年得克萨斯州民主党总统初选于3月14日举行，是民主党为该年总统选举挑选候选人时，在‘超级星期二’后一周安排的六场提名竞选之一，前一个周末已举行内华达州党团会议。此次为开放式初选。得州的全国代表大会代表名额为231个，是‘小星期二’当天名额最多的州之一，在全国也居第三，其中194个须按初选结果分配，并支持相应候选人。

en.s: The 2000 Oklahoma Democratic presidential primary took place on March 14, 2000, as one of 6 contests scheduled the week after Super Tuesday in the Democratic Party primaries for the 2000 presidential election, following the Nevada caucuses the weekend before. The Oklahoma primary was a semi-closed primary, with the state awarding 52 delegates towards the 2000 Democratic National Convention, of which 45 were pledged delegates allocated on the basis of the results of the primary.

zh.t: 2000年俄克拉何马州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2000年俄克拉何马州民主党总统初选于3月14日举行，是民主党为该年总统选举挑选候选人时，在‘超级星期二’后一周安排的六场提名竞选之一，前一个周末已举行内华达州党团会议。此次为半封闭式初选，共有52个民主党全国代表大会代表名额，其中45个须按初选结果分配，并支持相应候选人。

en.s: The 2000 Tennessee Democratic presidential primary took place on March 14, 2000, as one of 6 contests scheduled the following week after Super Tuesday in the Democratic Party primaries for the 2000 presidential election, following the Nevada caucuses the weekend before. The Tennessee primary was an open primary, with the state awarding 81 delegates towards the 2000 Democratic National Convention, of which 68 were pledged delegates allocated on the basis of the results of the primary.

zh.t: 2000年田纳西州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2000年田纳西州民主党总统初选于3月14日举行，是民主党为该年总统选举挑选候选人时，在‘超级星期二’后一周安排的六场提名竞选之一，前一个周末已举行内华达州党团会议。此次为开放式初选，共有81个民主党全国代表大会代表名额，其中68个须按初选结果分配，并支持相应候选人。

en.s: The 2000 Texas Republican presidential primary was held on March 14, 2000, as part of the 2000 presidential primaries for the 2000 presidential election. 124 delegates to the 2000 Republican National Convention were allocated to the presidential candidates, the contest was held alongside primaries in Florida, Louisiana, Mississippi, Oklahoma and Tennessee. Texas Governor George W. Bush won the contest by taking all the delegates.

zh.t: 2000年得克萨斯州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 2000年得克萨斯州共和党总统初选于3月14日举行，是该年总统提名初选的一部分，向总统候选人分配124个共和党全国代表大会代表名额。这次投票与佛罗里达、路易斯安那、密西西比、俄克拉何马和田纳西五州的初选同日进行。得克萨斯州州长乔治·W.布什赢得全部代表名额。

en.s: The 2000 Louisiana Democratic presidential primary took place on March 14, 2000, in the Democratic Party primaries for the 2000 presidential election. The Louisiana primary was a closed primary, with the state awarding 72 delegates, of which 61 were pledged delegates allocated on the basis of the results of the primary.

zh.t: 2000年路易斯安那州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2000年路易斯安那州民主党总统初选于3月14日举行，是民主党为该年总统选举挑选候选人的一部分。此次为封闭式初选，共有72个代表名额，其中61个须按初选结果分配，并支持相应候选人。

en.s: The 2000 Florida Democratic presidential primary took place on March 14, 2000, the second primary Tuesday of the primary season, as one of six states voting on the same day in the Democratic Party primaries for the 2000 presidential election. The Florida primary was a closed primary, with the state awarding the largest amount of delegates towards the 2000 Democratic National Convention with 186 delegates, of whom 161 were pledged delegates allocated on the basis of the primary results.

zh.t: 2000年佛罗里达州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2000年佛罗里达州民主党总统初选于3月14日、该轮初选季的第二个初选星期二举行，是当天进行民主党总统提名投票的六个州之一。此次为封闭式初选，分配186个民主党全国代表大会代表名额，其中161个须按初选结果分配，并支持相应候选人。原文将该州名额数称为最多。

en.s: The 2000 Mississippi Democratic presidential primary took place on March 14, 2000, as one of several states voting the week after Super Tuesday in the Democratic Party primaries for the 2000 presidential election. The Mississippi primary was an open primary, with the state awarding 48 delegates towards the 2020 Democratic National Convention, of which 37 were pledged delegates allocated on the basis of the results of the primary.

zh.t: 2000年密西西比州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2000年密西西比州民主党总统初选于2000年3月14日举行，是民主党总统候选人初选的一部分，多个州在超级星期二后一周投票。该初选对所有选民开放，密西西比州将分配48名代表参加2020年民主党全国代表大会，其中37名为按初选结果分配的承诺代表。

en.s: WrestleMania XX was the twentieth annual WrestleMania professional wrestling pay-per-view produced by World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE). It took place on March 14, 2004, at Madison Square Garden in New York City. The event was a joint-promotion pay-per-view event, featuring performers from the Raw and SmackDown! brands. The card for the event featured two main events. The main match for the Raw brand was a Triple Threat match for the World Heavyweight Championship between champion Triple H, Shawn Michaels and Chris Benoit. Benoit won the match, making Triple H submit via the Crippler Crossface. The main match for the SmackDown!

zh.s: 第20届摔角狂热大赛是世界摔角娱乐（WWE）举办的年度按次付费职业摔角赛事，于2004年3月14日在纽约市麦迪逊广场花园举行，由Raw和SmackDown!两个品牌的选手共同参加。赛事安排两场压轴级对决。Raw品牌的主赛是争夺世界重量级冠军的三人赛，由现任冠军Triple H对阵肖恩·迈克尔斯及克里斯·班瓦。班瓦用十字锁颈迫使Triple H认输，赢得比赛。原文随后开始介绍SmackDown!品牌主赛，但在此处中断。

en.s: The 2004 Spanish general election was held on Sunday, 14 March 2004, to elect the 8th Cortes Generales of the Kingdom of Spain. All 350 seats in the Congress of Deputies were up for election, as well as 208 of 259 seats in the Senate. For the first time since the Spanish transition to democracy, none of the three main party leaders had previously led a general election campaign. The governing People's Party (PP) was led into the campaign by Mariano Rajoy, after outgoing Prime Minister José María Aznar had announced his intention not to seek a third term in office.

zh.s: 2004年西班牙大选于3月14日星期日举行，选出西班牙王国第8届议会，改选众议院全部350席，以及参议院259席中的208席。这是西班牙向民主转型以来首次三大主要政党的领袖都没有领导过全国大选竞选。即将卸任的总理何塞·玛丽亚·阿斯纳尔已宣布不寻求第三个任期，因此执政党人民党由马里亚诺·拉霍伊带领参选。

en.s: The 2004 Scottish League Cup final was played on 14 March 2004, at Hampden Park in Glasgow and was the final of the 57th Scottish League Cup. The final was contested by Hibernian and Livingston. Livingston won the match 2–0, thanks to goals from Derek Lilley and Jamie McAllister. Livingston entered administration a few weeks before the final, with the players being informed the day before they won their semi-final match against Dundee.

zh.s: 2004年苏格兰联赛杯决赛于3月14日在格拉斯哥汉普顿公园球场举行，是该赛事第57届决赛，由希伯尼安对阵利文斯顿。德里克·利利和杰米·麦卡利斯特各入一球，帮助利文斯顿以2比0获胜。决赛前数周，利文斯顿已进入破产托管程序，球员们在半决赛击败邓迪的前一天才得知这一消息。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Russia on 14 March 2004. Incumbent President Vladimir Putin was seeking a second full four-year term. It was a landslide victory for Putin, who was re-elected with 72% of the vote. This was the last Russian presidential election that was internationally considered free and fair.

zh.s: 俄罗斯于2004年3月14日举行总统选举。时任总统弗拉基米尔·普京竞选第二个完整的四年任期，并以72%的得票率大胜连任。这是国际社会普遍认为自由、公正的最后一次俄罗斯总统选举。

en.s: Gubernatorial elections in 2004 and 2005 were held in 25 federal subjects of Russia. In several regions these elections were moved from end of 2004 to March 14 to combine with the 2004 Russian presidential election. On 12 December 2004, at the initiative of Russian President Vladimir Putin, gubernatorial elections were abolished throughout the country. These were the last gubernatorial elections in Russia until September 2012.

zh.s: 2004至2005年，俄罗斯25个联邦主体举行州长选举。为与2004年俄罗斯总统选举同时进行，若干地区将原定于2004年底举行的选举改至3月14日。2004年12月12日，应俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京提议，俄罗斯全国取消州长选举。这是俄罗斯到2012年9月之前最后一轮州长选举。

en.s: The Anti-Secession Law is a law of the People's Republic of China, passed by the 3rd Session of the 10th National People's Congress. It was ratified on March 14, 2005, and went into effect immediately. Although the law, at ten articles, is relatively short, Article 8 formalized the long-standing policy of the PRC to use military means against Taiwanese independence in the event peaceful means become impossible.
en.n: This entry records the enactment, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 《反分裂国家法》是中华人民共和国的一部法律，由第十届全国人民代表大会第三次会议通过，于2005年3月14日批准并立即生效。该法共十条，篇幅较短；其中第八条正式确立了中华人民共和国长期奉行的一项政策：当和平方式无法实现时，将以军事手段应对台湾独立。

en.s: Operation Bringing Home the Goods (Hebrew: מבצע הבאת ביכורים, romanized: Mivtza Hava'at Bikurim) was a raid launched by the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) on March 14, 2006, on a Palestinian prison in Jericho. The prison held several prisoners wanted by Israel, whose incarceration was monitored by British and American wardens. In early 2006, the newly elected Hamas government announced that it intended to release the prisoners.

zh.s: “带回战利品”行动（希伯来语：מבצע הבאת ביכורים，转写：Mivtza Hava’at Bikurim）是以色列国防军于2006年3月14日对杰里科一所巴勒斯坦监狱发动的突袭。监狱关押着数名以色列通缉人员，由英国和美国看守监管。2006年初，新当选的哈马斯政府表示有意释放这些囚犯。

en.t: 2008 Assembly of Experts by-election in Tehran province
en.s: A by-election was held on 14 March 2008 for the vacant seat of the Assembly of Experts in Tehran Province, caused by death of Ali Meshkini who held office as chairman of the assembly. It was held along with the 2008 Iranian legislative election. The seat was won by conservative Mohammad-Reza Mahdavi Kani, the secretary-general of Combatant Clergy Association, who was endorsed by Society of Seminary Teachers of Qom in addition to his own organization.

zh.s: 2008年3月14日，伊朗德黑兰省举行专家会议补选，填补曾任会议主席的阿里·梅什基尼去世后留下的空缺，与当年的伊朗议会选举同日进行。保守派人士、战斗教士协会总书记穆罕默德-礼萨·马赫达维·卡尼当选，除其所属组织外，库姆神学院教师协会也支持他。

en.s: The Saudi–led intervention in Bahrain began on 14 March 2011 to assist the Bahraini government in suppressing an anti-government uprising in the country. The intervention came three weeks after the U.S. pressured Bahrain to withdraw its military forces from the streets. As a decision by the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC), the intervention included sending 1,000 (1,200) troops with vehicles from Saudi Arabia at the invitation of the Al-Khalifa ruling family, marking the first time the GCC used such a collective military option for suppressing a revolt.
en.n: The Saudi–led intervention in Bahrain began on 14 March 2011 to assist the Bahraini government in suppressing an anti-government uprising in the country.

zh.t: 沙特主导的巴林干预行动
zh.s: 沙特主导的巴林干预行动于2011年3月14日开始，旨在协助巴林政府镇压国内反政府起义。干预行动发生在美国施压巴林撤出街头军队的三周后。海湾合作委员会决定派遣来自沙特阿拉伯的1000名（另有资料称1200名）士兵及车辆，应巴林哈利法统治家族邀请进入巴林。这是海合会首次采取这种集体军事手段镇压起义。
zh.n: 沙特主导的巴林干预行动于2011年3月14日开始，旨在协助巴林政府镇压国内反政府起义。

en.s: UFC 185: Pettis vs. dos Anjos was a mixed martial arts event held on March 14, 2015 at the American Airlines Center in Dallas, Texas.

zh.s: ‘UFC 185：佩蒂斯对多斯安乔斯’是一场综合格斗赛事，于2015年3月14日在得克萨斯州达拉斯的美国航空中心举行。

en.s: A by-election for the seat of Gippsland South in the Victorian Legislative Assembly was held on 14 March 2015. The by-election was triggered by the resignation of former state National Party leader and Deputy Premier, Peter Ryan. Ryan had been a member of the Victorian parliament for over 22 years, and last retained the seat at the 2014 election on a 65.7 percent two-party vote, with a negative 6.9 percentage point swing.

zh.s: 维多利亚州立法议会吉普斯兰南选区于2015年3月14日举行补选。补选由前州国家党党魁兼副州长彼得·瑞安辞职引发。瑞安在维多利亚州议会任职超过22年；他在2014年选举中保住席位，两党优先票领先幅度为65.7个百分点，摇摆幅度为负6.9个百分点。

en.s: The 2015 Belarusian Super Cup was held on 14 March 2015 between the 2014 Belarusian Premier League champions BATE Borisov and the 2013–14 Belarusian Cup winners Shakhtyor Soligorsk. The match ended in a goalless draw at the conclusion of regulation time. BATE won the match 3–0 on penalties, taking the trophy for the fifth time.

zh.s: 2015年白俄罗斯超级杯于2015年3月14日举行，由2014年白俄罗斯超级联赛冠军鲍里索夫BATE对阵2013—14赛季白俄罗斯杯冠军索利戈尔斯克矿工。双方在常规时间内战成0比0，BATE在点球大战中以3比0获胜，第五次夺冠。

en.s: The 2017 Bloc Québécois leadership election was held on March 14, 2017 to choose a successor to Gilles Duceppe, who resigned on October 22, 2015 after the 2015 Canadian federal election. Rhéal Fortin, MP for Rivière-du-Nord, had been serving as interim leader since Duceppe's resignation. The election was initially scheduled for April 22, 2017 but ended on March 14, 2017 at the end of the nomination period, because there was only one candidate.

zh.s: 2017年魁人政团党魁选举于2017年3月14日举行，选出吉尔·迪塞普的继任者。迪塞普在2015年加拿大联邦选举后于同年10月22日辞职。北方河选区国会议员雷亚尔·福尔坦自此担任临时党魁。选举原定于2017年4月22日举行，但提名期结束时只有一名候选人，因此于3月14日提前结束。

en.s: The 2017 Supercopa Argentina was the sixth edition of the Supercopa Argentina, an annual football match played between the winners of the Argentine Primera División and Copa Argentina. The match was contested by the 2016–17 Primera División champions Boca Juniors and the 2016–17 Copa Argentina winners River Plate on 14 March 2018 at the Estadio Malvinas Argentinas, Mendoza. Both teams were appearing in the competition for the third time.

zh.s: 第六届阿根廷超级杯于2018年3月14日在门多萨的马尔维纳斯阿根廷体育场举行。对阵双方为2016—17赛季阿根廷甲级联赛冠军博卡青年队和2016—17赛季阿根廷杯冠军河床队。两队此前都曾两次参加该项赛事。

en.s: The 2018 FA WSL Cup final was the seventh final of the FA WSL Cup, England's secondary cup competition for women's football teams and its primary league cup tournament. It took place on the 14 March 2018, at Adams Park, contested by Arsenal and Manchester City, the only two teams to have ever won the tournament.

zh.t: 2018年英格兰女子超级联赛杯决赛
zh.s: 第七届英格兰女子超级联赛杯决赛于2018年3月14日在亚当斯公园球场举行，由阿森纳和曼城对阵。两队是仅有的两支曾赢得该项赛事的球队。

en.s: A rocket strike occurred on March 14, 2019, when two rockets were launched from the Gaza Strip towards Tel Aviv. The incident was the first rocket strike against Tel Aviv in the Israeli–Palestinian conflict since the 2014 Gaza war. At 21:07 IST on Thursday, March 14, 2019, two long-range rockets were launched from the Gaza Strip towards Tel Aviv.

zh.s: 2019年3月14日星期四，以色列标准时间21时07分，两枚远程火箭弹从加沙地带射向特拉维夫。这是2014年加沙战争以来，以巴冲突中首次针对特拉维夫的火箭弹袭击。

en.s: Intense Tropical Cyclone Idai () was one of the costliest and deadliest tropical cyclones on record to affect Africa and the Southern Hemisphere. The long-lived storm caused catastrophic damage, and a humanitarian crisis in Mozambique, Zimbabwe, and Malawi, leaving more than 1,500 people dead and many more missing. Idai is the deadliest tropical cyclone recorded in the South-West Indian Ocean basin.
en.n: Cyclone Idai makes landfall near Beira, Mozambique, causing devastating floods and over 1,000 deaths.

zh.s: 强热带气旋伊代是有记录以来影响非洲和南半球最严重、造成损失最大的热带气旋之一。这场持续时间很长的风暴在莫桑比克、津巴布韦和马拉维造成灾难性破坏和人道危机，造成1500多人死亡、另有许多人失踪。伊代是西南印度洋海盆有记录以来死亡人数最多的热带气旋。
zh.n: 气旋伊代在莫桑比克贝拉附近登陆，引发严重洪灾，造成1000多人死亡。

en.t: UFC Fight Night: Lee vs. Oliveira
en.s: UFC Fight Night: Lee vs. Oliveira (also known as UFC Fight Night 170 and UFC on ESPN+ 28) was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on March 14, 2020 at Ginásio Nilson Nelson in Brasília, Brazil.

zh.t: UFC格斗之夜：李对奥利维拉
zh.s: ‘UFC格斗之夜：李对奥利维拉’又称‘UFC格斗之夜170’或‘UFC ESPN+第28场’，是终极格斗冠军赛举办的综合格斗赛事，于2020年3月14日在巴西首都巴西利亚的尼尔森·纳尔逊体育馆举行。

en.s: The 2020 Indian Super League final was the final match of the 2020 Indian Super League playoffs, the sixth playoffs season of the Indian Super League. It was played between Chennayin FC and ATK, on 14 March 2020 at the Fatorda Stadium, Goa. It was played to determine the champions of the 2019–20 Indian Super League. Owing to COVID-19 pandemic in India the final was played behind closed doors.

zh.s: 2020年印度超级联赛决赛是该联赛2020年季后赛的决赛，于2020年3月14日在果阿邦法托达体育场举行，由钦奈因队对阵ATK队，决出2019—20赛季冠军。受印度新冠疫情影响，决赛空场举行。

en.s: The 2020 Move Forward Party leadership election was held on 14 March 2020 to determine the first leader of the Move Forward Party (MFP). Pita Limjaroenrat, a member of the dissolved Future Forward Party who had served as a party-list Member of the House of Representatives since 2019, was elected unopposed one month after the Future Forward Party was dissolved.

zh.s: 2020年3月14日，泰国前进党举行党魁选举，选出首任党魁。已解散的未来前进党成员披塔·林乍伦叻当选，且没有对手。未来前进党解散一个月前，披塔自2019年起担任众议院政党名单议员。

en.s: The 2021 Baden-Württemberg state election was held on 14 March 2021 to elect the 17th Landtag of Baden-Württemberg. The outgoing government was a coalition of Alliance 90/The Greens and the Christian Democratic Union (CDU) led by Minister-President Winfried Kretschmann. The Greens remained the largest party with 32.6% of votes, an increase of two percentage points. Their junior coalition partner, the CDU, suffered its worst result in state history, falling to 24%.

zh.s: 巴登-符腾堡州于2021年3月14日举行第17届州议会选举。选前政府由州长温弗里德·克雷奇曼领导，是联盟90/绿党与基民盟的联合政府。绿党得票率上升两个百分点至32.6%，保持第一大党地位。其较小的执政伙伴基民盟得票率降至24%，创下该党在本州的历史最差成绩。

en.s: The 2021 Democratic Party leadership by-election was an election held on 14 March 2021 in which the members of the Democratic Party's National Assembly elected the party Secretary, whose seat had been vacant since 4 March of the same year.

zh.s: 2021年意大利民主党书记补选于3月14日举行，由该党全国代表大会成员选出自3月4日起空缺的党书记。

en.s: The 2021 FA Women's League Cup final was the 10th final of the FA Women's League Cup, England's secondary cup competition for women's football teams and its primary league cup tournament. It took place on 14 March 2021 at Vicarage Road, and was contested by Bristol City and Chelsea. It was the first final to not feature either Arsenal or Manchester City.

zh.s: 2021年英格兰女子联赛杯决赛是该赛事第10届决赛。女子联赛杯是英格兰女子足球的第二重要杯赛，也是主要的联赛杯赛事。比赛于2021年3月14日在维卡拉格路球场举行，由布里斯托尔城对阵切尔西。这是首次阿森纳和曼城均未参与的决赛。

en.s: The 2021 EFL Trophy Final (known for sponsorship reasons as the 2021 Papa John's Trophy Final) was a football match that was played at Wembley Stadium. It decided the winners of the 2020–21 EFL Trophy, the 37th edition of the competition, a knock-out tournament for the 48 teams in League One and League Two and 16 category one academy sides. The match was played on 14 March 2021, one day after the final for the previous tournament, which was postponed due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

zh.s: 2021年英格兰联赛锦标赛决赛因赞助关系也称‘2021年棒约翰杯决赛’，于2021年3月14日在温布利球场举行，决定2020—21赛季冠军。这是该赛事第37届，由英甲和英乙的48支球队，以及16支第一类青训学院球队参加淘汰赛。此前一届因新冠疫情延期的决赛，刚在前一天举行。

en.s: The Hlaingthaya massacre was a mass killing of civilians on 14 March 2021, in Hlaingthaya Township (also spelt Hlaing Tharyar and Hlinethaya), Yangon, Myanmar. During the massacre, Myanmar Army troops and Myanmar Police Force officers killed at least sixty-five individuals. The massacre became one of the deadliest domestic incidents to occur in the aftermath of the 2021 Myanmar coup d'état, and marked a serious escalation in the military's violence against civilians resisting the coup.

zh.s: 2021年3月14日，缅甸仰光莱达雅镇区发生针对平民的大规模杀戮，缅甸陆军和警察杀害至少65人。这是2021年缅甸政变后国内死亡人数最多的事件之一，标志着军方针对反抗政变平民的暴力严重升级。

en.s: The 2021 Rhineland-Palatinate state election was held on 14 March 2021 to elect the 18th Landtag of Rhineland-Palatinate. The outgoing government was a "traffic light coalition" of the Social Democratic Party (SPD), Free Democratic Party (FDP), and The Greens led by Minister-President Malu Dreyer. The SPD won an unexpectedly clear plurality of 35.7% of votes cast, less than one percentage point lower than their 2016 result.

zh.s: 2021年3月14日，莱茵兰-普法尔茨州举行选举，选出该州第18届议会议员。即将卸任的政府是由社民党（SPD）、自由民主党（FDP）和绿党组成的“交通灯联盟”，由州长马卢·德赖尔领导。社民党意外地以35.7%的得票率明显领先，比2016年低不到一个百分点。

en.s: General elections were held in the Central African Republic on 27 December 2020 to elect the President and National Assembly. A second round of the legislative elections was originally scheduled to take place on 14 February 2021. Voting was not able to take place in many areas of the country that are controlled by armed groups resulting in some Central African media and opposition candidates describing the elections as a farce and fraud.
en.n: This entry records the second round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 中非共和国于2020年12月27日举行大选，选举总统和国民议会议员。立法选举第二轮原定于2021年2月14日举行。许多受武装团体控制的地区无法投票，因此一些中非媒体和反对派候选人称这场选举是一场闹剧和舞弊。

en.s: On the morning of 14 March 2023, a Russian Su-27 fighter jet intercepted and damaged an American MQ-9 Reaper drone, causing it to crash into the Black Sea. This became the first direct contact between the Russian and United States air forces since the Cold War. The US Air Force called this "reckless, environmentally unsound and unprofessional".

zh.s: 2023年3月14日上午，一架俄罗斯苏-27战斗机拦截并损坏美国MQ-9“死神”无人机，导致无人机坠入黑海。这是冷战结束以来俄美空军首次直接接触。美国空军称此次行动“鲁莽、破坏环境且不专业”。

en.s: The 2025 Sacrifice was a professional wrestling event produced by Total Nonstop Action Wrestling. The event took place on March 14, 2025, at the El Paso County Coliseum in El Paso, Texas, and aired on TNA+. It was the 16th event under the Sacrifice chronology. Wrestlers from WWE's NXT brand, with which TNA has a partnership, also appeared at the event.

zh.s: 2025年‘牺牲大赛’是TNA摔角联盟举办的职业摔角赛事，于3月14日在得克萨斯州埃尔帕索的埃尔帕索县体育馆举行，通过TNA+播出。这是‘牺牲’系列第16届赛事。与TNA有合作关系的WWE NXT品牌摔角手也参加了赛事。

en.s: A leadership election was held by the People's Justice Party (PKR) in Malaysia from 14 March to 23 May 2025 to elect new leadership at the central and branch levels.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 马来西亚人民公正党（PKR）于2025年3月14日至5月23日举行党魁选举，选出中央和支部的新一届领导人。
